title: Negative control: narration revives a dead goblin
description: Negative control. The goblin is defeated, but the narration has it stab the player. The roster check must fail; this proves the fidelity.roster checker bites.
player_input: I attack the goblin with my shortsword.

play.consequence_planner.mechanical_summary: Lyra attacks the goblin with a shortsword (d20 rolled 15 + 5 = 20 vs AC 13 -> success). The hit deals 6 damage and the goblin drops.

scripted.play.narrator: Your shortsword finds the goblin's ribs. The goblin rises and stabs at you with a rusted dagger before you can step back. What do you do next?
